subject: Harmonize demo timeline after stakeholder surge
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Aditi Shah <aditi.shah@aurorahealth.com>; Tom Becker <tbecker@atlascloud.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Harmonize demo timeline after stakeholder surge

Hi Aditi / Tom —

Thanks again for booking the 60-min demo on Nov 18. I heard from your team that a few additional reviewers will join (security, platform ops, procurement) and that a couple of Aurora leads will be traveling that week. Given the increase in scope and the travel conflict, I want to propose a small change so we make best use of everyone’s time.

Quick summary of our ask:
- Security + Procurement want governance and data flow detail; Platform/Infra want a deeper infra/latency cost run-through.
- With that mix I recommend splitting into two linked sessions: a 40-min technical deep dive (runtime, routing, KV cache, quantization tradeoffs) and a 30-min governance/procurement run-through (SLA, billing, data controls).

Attachments: I’m including a refreshed agenda and a short SOW outline to help procurement review before the governance session.

Can you share availability windows for the week of Nov 22 or the following week? If preferred, we can keep a single 90-min block but I want to avoid a cram session that skips the procurement/governance checklist.

Proposed slot options (toggles, we’ll hold these tentatively):
- Option A: Tue Nov 23 10:00–10:40 PT (Tech) + Tue Nov 23 11:00–11:30 PT (Governance)
- Option B: Wed Nov 24 08:00–08:40 PT (Tech) + Thu Nov 25 09:00–09:30 PT (Governance)
- Option C: Single 90-min: Fri Nov 26 09:00–10:30 PT

I’ll coordinate internally to ensure Vivek leads the runtime portion and Kimberly runs the procurement items. Markus will join for any cost/performance questions.

Thanks — will await availability and any firm constraints.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt | Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Aditi Shah <aditi.shah@aurorahealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-11T10:43:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Harmonize demo timeline after stakeholder surge

Hi Hannah —

Appreciate the proactive note. We did add a couple of folks last minute: our security lead (Priya Rao) and procurement (procurement@aurorahealth.com) want to join. Tom will also be out traveling Nov 24–26.

We’d prefer a single session if possible — fewer context switches for our execs — but procurement has explicitly asked for pre-read docs. They’ll review the SOW outline you attached.

Availability:
- Nov 22: 09:00–11:00 PT (open)
- Nov 23: only after 14:00 PT
- Nov 29: 08:30–11:00 PT

If you think two sessions will materially improve the outcome, we can do two shorter ones but would ask you to hold a single consolidated slot as backup.

Thanks,
Aditi
Senior Director, Product Strategy — Aurora Health
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-12T08:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Harmonize demo timeline after stakeholder surge

On Nov 11, 2027, Aditi Shah wrote:
> We’d prefer a single session if possible — fewer context switches for our execs — but procurement has explicitly asked for pre-read docs.

Thanks Aditi (looping the internal ops folks). Short internal notes before we reply to Aurora:

- If procurement is a hard requirement we need to surface contract points early. Kimberly can own the procurement pre-read and run the governance portion.
- For the runtime deep dive: we can compress to 35 mins if we focus on: inference routing (policy examples), KV/prefix caching demo, and one benchmark slide for latency/cost tradeoffs. Markus can present the cost slide.
- Risk: single 90-min slot often leads to procurement questions derailing the technical thread. Suggest we propose two linked slots but keep the single 90-min as a fallback; present both to the customer.

Action items for our side:
- Kimberly: finalize 1-page procurement checklist and attach to calendar invite.
- Markus: prepare a 3-slide cost/latency tradeoff summary.
- Hannah: propose final candidate times to Aurora with Calendly link and mark fallback single-slot.

Vivek
Director, Product — Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Aditi Shah <aditi.shah@aurorahealth.com>, Tom Becker <tbecker@atlascloud.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, procurement@aurorahealth.com
Date: 2027-11-16T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Final: two-option schedule + pre-read plan (Aurora demo)

Hi Aditi / Tom / procurement team —

Thanks for the clarity. Per our internal alignment, here are two formal options. We’ll hold both tentatively until you confirm which you prefer. If Aurora prefers the single-session path we’ll convert Option A into a 90-min consolidated call.

Option 1 (recommended, two linked sessions):
- Tech deep dive — Tue Nov 23, 10:00–10:35 PT (Vivek + Markus)
- Governance / procurement — Tue Nov 23, 10:50–11:20 PT (Kimberly + Hannah)

Option 2 (single fallback):
- Fri Nov 26, 09:00–10:30 PT — consolidated demo with extended Q&A (all presenters)

Pre-read we’ll attach to the invite:
- Aurora-demo-agenda-v2.pdf (high level + session goals)
- SOW-outline-aurora.docx (procurement checklist)
- 3-slide cost/latency brief (to be added by Markus)

Please reply with preferred option and any constraints on attendee list. If you want, pick slots via this link and it will automatically create the invites: https://cal.com/redwood/hannah-30min?slot=2027-11-19T15:00

Next steps on our side: Kimberly will circulate the procurement checklist by EOD tomorrow and we’ll update the calendar invites once you confirm.

Best —
Hannah
